body.label: Effect
body.html: Ignore ordinary visual concealment for this attack. On success, deal 1 Slashing Damage.

surges.html: Learn whether the target has a higher Fortitude or Composure.
Deal +1 Damage if the target voluntarily moved since your last turn.

rider.title: Adaptation - Predator
rider.html: Assume Whiskers (upkeep 0): you detect the occupied space of moving creatures within 2 units on the same continuous surface, but not their identity or through solid walls.
